data.action: 赤身伫立在沸腾熔池边，红光勾勒身姿
data.description: 地热工坊沸腾的红光照亮了整座岩洞，赤身伫立在池边的莱万汀身姿婀娜挺拔，火光在她紧致无暇的胴体上勾勒出动人心魄的完美轮廓。她向你张开双臂——「这里没有寒冷也没有顾虑……来吧，管理员，让我们在这片熔光之中尽情燃烧！」
data.promptProse: Laevatain opens both arms toward the viewer from the basalt beside the molten pool. Low red lava glow outlines her figure and the near rock edge against the shadowed cavern walls.
data.title: 莱万汀 · 熔池畔
data.animaCaption: She opens both arms toward the viewer from the basalt beside the molten pool.
